answer.book: Two works in one volume: Hermanni Witsii Exercitationes sacrae in Symbolum quod Apostolorum dicitur, with front matter (dedication, Ad lectorem, Scazon, list of respondents), 26 exercitationes on the Creed and an index; then Exercitationes in Orationem Dominicam, with an address to students, an alloquium, 14 exercitationes and an index.
